press.sentence: Updated SolidWorks: made Sun meshes Planet copy 1, Sun meshes Planet copy 2, Sun meshes Planet copy 3 and Planet copy 1 meshes Ring again, with their flags set in every mode, changed 1 variable in Gear_m1.25_N29 (it now has 28 teeth; its file keeps its name), changed 1 variable in Gear_m1.25_N13 (it now has 14 teeth; its file keeps its name), changed 1 variable in Ring_m1.25_N55 (it now has 56 teeth; its file keeps its name), set the gear mates Sun meshes Planet copy 1 to 28 : 14, Sun meshes Planet copy 2 to 28 : 14, Sun meshes Planet copy 3 to 28 : 14 and Planet copy 1 meshes Ring to 14 : 56, re-placed Ring, Carrier (the carrier), Sun, Planet (3 copies), HighDog, LowDog and RangeSlv in every mode; no interference between the gears in any mode, where they stand. It worked in H, the configuration that was active, then showed and checked N and L and left the assembly in H. Your Sprocket-1 went with Sun in every mode, which your locks hold it to. Your Sprocket-3 went with Sun in every mode, which your locks hold it to. Your Sprocket-2 went with RangeSlv in every mode, which your locks hold it to. Save Gear_m1.25_N29, Gear_m1.25_N13, Ring_m1.25_N55 and RangeBox in SolidWorks to keep them.
